description: Check the status of up to 25 SaaS or cloud vendors in one call, for "is my stack down?" questions: per-vendor status and a list of the ones not operational, read live from PulseWatch. Use vendor_status when you need incident detail for a single vendor. Untracked names are reported, not fatal. Not charged if none of the vendors is tracked or every lookup fails. Read-only; one flat price of $0.05 USDC via x402 (payment goes in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: multi_vendor_status
